pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Bhaddāya Kāpilāniyā antevāsikā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā gāmakaṃ ñātikulaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.3: Bhaddā Kāpilānī taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apassantī bhikkhuniyo pucchi: kahaṃ itthannāmā, na dissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.4: bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ayye bhaṇḍitvā na dissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.5: amma amukasmiṃ gāmake etissā ñātikulaṃ, tattha gantvā vicinathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.6: bhikkhuniyo tattha gantvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ passitvā etad avocuṃ: kissa tvaṃ ayye ekikā āgatā. kacci 'si appadhaṃsitā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gaccheyya, ayam pi bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:1.17: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhuniyo Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.3: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo nāvike upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ: sādhu no āvuso tārethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.4: nāyye sakkā ubho sakiṃ tāretun ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.13: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:2.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī ekā nadīpāraṃ gacchissatīti.

pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gantvā sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.2: tattha aññatarā bhikkhunī abhirūpā hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā. aññataro puriso tassā bhikkhuniyā saha dassanena paṭibaddhacitto hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.3: atha kho so puriso tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ seyyaṃ paññāpento tassā bhikkhuniyā seyyaṃ ekamantaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.4: atha kho sā bhikkhunī sallakkhetvā pariyuṭṭhito ayaṃ puriso, sace rattiṃ āgacchissati vissaro me bhavissatīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.5: bhikkhuniyo anāpucchā aññataraṃ kulaṃ gantvā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.6: atha kho so puriso rattiṃ āgantvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ gavesanto bhikkhuniyo ghaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.7: bhikkhuniyo taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apassantiyo evam āhaṃsu: nissaṃsayaṃ kho sā bhikkhunī purisena saddhiṃ nikkhantā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss3:3.8: atha kho sā bhikkhunī tassā rattiyā accayena yena tā bhikkhuniyo ten' upasaṃkami. bhikkhuniyo taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avocuṃ: kissa tvaṃ ayye purisena saddhiṃ nikkhantā 'ti.
